title: Candle Ad Without Photos
tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcription reports speech, “여름이야기”, violating the explicit no-voice requirement.

judge.summary: The warm vertical candle ad matches the requested product and text, but unwanted speech makes an audio revision necessary.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is reported as 15 seconds, and its sampled frames are in vertical 9:16 format.

must_haves.item: The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
must_haves.why: All sampled frames show a clear cylindrical glass jar with ivory wax, a single visible wick and no label.

must_haves.item: The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
must_haves.why: The jar, wax level, single wick and unlabeled appearance remain visually consistent.

must_haves.item: Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
must_haves.why: Warm amber lighting and calm product framing are evident, but still frames cannot establish the smoothness or pace of camera movement.

must_haves.item: “A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The first phrase is readable at 1.9 seconds and the closing phrase at 13.2 seconds, both spelled exactly.

must_haves.item: Soft piano is audible with no speech.
must_haves.why: The audio report explicitly identifies speech, “여름이야기”; whether soft piano is present cannot be established from the transcription.
